prompt:

From: Sarah Kim, Project Manager
To: All Team Members
Subject: Project meeting

I need to move our weekly project meeting from Tuesday to Wednesday because of a client visit. Please tell me whether you can attend on Wednesday at 10 A.M. If not, suggest another time. Also, let me know if you need any materials to be prepared in advance.
sample_answer:
Dear Ms. Kim,

Thank you for letting us know about the schedule change. I am able to attend the meeting on Wednesday at 10 A.M., so there is no need to change the time.

Regarding materials, I would appreciate it if you could send me the latest budget report before the meeting so that I can review it. I will also bring the updated project timeline.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Best regards,
Anh Nguyen

title: Technology in Education
prompt:
Do you agree or disagree with the following statement? Use specific reasons and examples to support your answer.

"Students learn more effectively when teachers use technology in the classroom."
sample_answer:
I agree that students learn more effectively when teachers use technology in the classroom. Technology makes lessons more interesting and gives students access to a wide range of information.

Firstly, technology helps students understand difficult ideas through visual and interactive content. For instance, when my science teacher showed a short animation of how the heart works, the whole class understood the topic much faster than by reading the textbook alone. Videos, simulations and educational apps turn abstract information into something students can see and practice.

In addition, technology allows students to learn at their own pace. With online exercises and recorded lessons, a student who needs more time can review a lecture several times, while an advanced student can move on to more challenging materials. A classmate of mine improved her English by using a language app every evening, something that would be difficult in a traditional class with only one teacher.

On the other hand, technology can distract students if it is not used carefully. However, with clear rules and good planning by teachers, this problem can be managed.

In conclusion, I believe that technology, when used wisely, improves understanding and flexibility in learning, so teachers should include it in their lessons.
tips_md:
**Mẹo Write an Opinion Essay (30 phút, tối thiểu 300 từ):**
- Cấu trúc 4 đoạn: **Mở bài** (nêu quan điểm rõ ràng) -> **Thân bài 1** (lý do 1 + ví dụ) -> **Thân bài 2** (lý do 2 + ví dụ) -> **Kết bài** (nhắc lại quan điểm).
- Dành 3-5 phút lập dàn ý, 20-22 phút viết, 3-5 phút kiểm tra.
- Dùng từ nối: Firstly / In addition / For instance / On the other hand / In conclusion.
- Ưu tiên câu đơn giản nhưng đúng; ví dụ cụ thể từ đời sống/công việc làm bài thuyết phục hơn.

title: City or Countryside
prompt: Some people prefer to live in a big city, while others prefer a small town or the countryside. Which do you prefer? Use specific reasons and examples to support your answer.
sample_answer:
Personally, I prefer living in a big city because it offers more opportunities and greater convenience.

Firstly, cities provide many more job opportunities. Large companies, international organizations and start-ups are usually located in urban areas, which allows people to choose from a wide range of careers. For example, after graduating, my cousin moved from a small town to Ho Chi Minh City and found a well-paid job in his field within a month. In his hometown, he would have had very few choices.

Secondly, daily life in a city is more convenient. Hospitals, shopping centers, schools and public transportation are close to where people live, so they can save time. I can buy groceries, see a doctor or meet friends within twenty minutes of my apartment. In rural areas, even simple tasks may require a long trip.

It is true that cities can be crowded and noisy, and living costs are higher. Nevertheless, these disadvantages are acceptable compared with the benefits of career growth and convenience.

In conclusion, I choose city life because it gives me better opportunities and an easier daily routine.

title: Flexible Working Hours
prompt: Some companies allow employees to choose their own working hours. Do you think this is a good idea? Use specific reasons and examples to support your opinion.
sample_answer:
In my opinion, allowing employees to choose their own working hours is a good idea for both workers and companies.

The first reason is that flexible hours improve productivity. People have different energy levels during the day; some are most productive early in the morning, while others work better in the afternoon. For example, a friend of mine who is a software developer starts work at noon and stays late, and he says he makes far fewer mistakes than when he had to arrive at eight. When employees work at their best times, the quality of work increases.

The second reason is that flexibility helps employees balance work and personal life. Parents can take their children to school, and others can attend classes or avoid rush-hour traffic. Satisfied employees are less likely to quit, which saves companies the cost of recruiting and training new staff.

Some managers worry that teamwork becomes harder if people are not in the office at the same time. This can be solved by setting core hours, such as 10 A.M. to 3 P.M., when everyone must be available.

In conclusion, flexible working hours increase productivity and satisfaction, so I strongly support this policy.

title: Influence of Advertising
prompt: Do you agree or disagree that advertising has too much influence on what people buy? Use specific reasons and examples to support your answer.
sample_answer:
I agree that advertising has too much influence on what people buy, and this often leads to unnecessary spending.

First, advertisements are designed to create desire, not just to give information. Companies use famous people, attractive music and emotional stories to make products seem essential. For instance, many teenagers insist on buying a particular brand of sneakers only because a famous athlete wears them, even though cheaper shoes are just as comfortable.

Second, online advertising is now personalized and almost impossible to avoid. After I searched for a camera once, I saw advertisements for cameras on every website for weeks, and I eventually bought one that I did not really need. This shows how constant exposure can push people to make impulse purchases.

Admittedly, advertising can be useful because it informs consumers about new products and helps small businesses grow. However, when it persuades people to buy things beyond their needs and budget, the negative effects outweigh the benefits.

In conclusion, advertising influences consumers more than it should, so people need to think carefully before they buy.

title: Teamwork or Individual Work
prompt: Some people prefer to work in a team, while others prefer to work alone. Which do you prefer, and why? Use specific reasons and examples to support your answer.
sample_answer:
I prefer to work in a team because it leads to better ideas and shared responsibility.

One major advantage of teamwork is the variety of perspectives. When people with different backgrounds discuss a problem, they can find solutions that one person might miss. For example, at my previous company, our marketing group included a designer, a writer and an analyst. Together we created a campaign that increased online sales by twenty percent, which I could not have achieved alone.

Another advantage is that team members can support one another. If one person is sick or overloaded, colleagues can take over some tasks, so deadlines are still met. Working with others also helps me learn new skills; I improved my presentation skills by watching how my teammates organized their slides.

Of course, teamwork has disadvantages. Meetings can take a long time, and conflicts sometimes occur. However, good communication and clear roles can reduce these problems.

In conclusion, although working alone has benefits such as independence, I believe teamwork produces better results and helps people grow, so it is my preferred way to work.
